avoid_supplements.name: High-dose calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Calcium can reduce intestinal motility and fluid secretion, potentially counteracting lubiprostone's mechanism of action
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2-4 hours; counsel on dietary calcium adequacy instead

avoid_supplements.name: Anticholinergic herbal supplements (belladonna, hyoscyamine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Anticholinergic effects inhibit GI motility and fluid secretion, directly opposing lubiprostone action
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; recommend alternative herbal remedies

caution_supplements.name: Psyllium husk and bulk-forming fiber supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause additive effects on bowel movements; excessive gas or bloating possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor patient tolerance; gradual introduction recommended with adequate hydration

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical benefit in supporting GI health; no direct interaction but may alter efficacy perception
caution_supplements.action: No restriction; patient may continue if tolerated

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Fat delays gastric emptying and may reduce lubiprostone absorption and local GI availability
avoid_foods.action: Take lubiprostone with food but limit fat content; counsel on light meal composition

caution_foods.name: Low-fiber diet foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Lack of fiber reduces treatment efficacy; lubiprostone works best with adequate dietary fiber
caution_foods.action: Encourage gradual increase in dietary fiber (fruits, vegetables, whole grains) to optimize therapeutic response

caution_foods.name: Dehydrating beverages (excessive caffeine, alcohol)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dehydration reduces lubiprostone efficacy by limiting available fluid for intestinal secretion
caution_foods.action: Counsel on adequate daily water intake (8-10 glasses); limit caffeine and alcohol

monitoring_notes: Lubiprostone undergoes minimal systemic metabolism, making drug-supplement interactions rare; however, GI effects can be optimized through dietary counsel. Monitor for abdominal distension, nausea, and diarrhea severity, adjusting lifestyle measures as needed.
